summary_en: 1,440 shares (30% stake) of Rex Co. to be acquired via negotiated purchase; Maruyoshi Center's ownership to rise from 70% to 100%. Share count 4,800 post-acquisition (議決権 480). Acquisition price withheld at counterparty request. Board approved 2026-08-19; settlement 2026-08-25. Rationale: strengthen group revenue base.
title_en: Notice Regarding Full Acquisition of Consolidated Subsidiary Shares through Additional Acquisition
translation_en_brief: Maruyoshi Center Inc. (7515) announced on 2026-08-19 that its board has approved the acquisition of the remaining 1,440 shares (30% stake) of consolidated subsidiary Rex Co. Ltd. (株式会社レックス), located in Ayagawa, Kagawa. Maruyoshi currently holds 70% (3,360 shares); upon completion of this negotiated acquisition, ownership will increase to 100% (4,800 shares total). The acquisition price has been withheld from disclosure at the counterparty's request. Settlement is scheduled for 2026-08-25. The acquisition is undertaken to strengthen the group's revenue base. Rex Co. operates transportation, warehousing, and office rental services. The company states the financial impact on consolidated results will be immaterial.
